question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` and these SDK token-budget helpers as a stable public `ContextEngine.assemble` contract now, or fold the signal into the broader assemble metadata RFC #82137?
rationale: The PR promotes a new public plugin SDK/API contract that can constrain third-party context-engine implementations while a broader overlapping API design remains open.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
options.body: Approve this focused API shape, then require branch refresh, SDK baseline/docs-map updates, and redacted real long-session proof before merge.

options.title: Fold Into RFC #82137
options.body: Pause or close this branch and handle token counts together with the broader provenance/internal-event assemble metadata design.

options.title: Keep SDK Surface Private
options.body: Avoid adding SDK helper exports until maintainers decide the permanent plugin-facing token-budget contract.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
recommendation.body: Approve this focused API shape, then require branch refresh, SDK baseline/docs-map updates, and redacted real long-session proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and have the most recent merged work on the exact context-engine budget path.
